instruction: Calculate the FIB-4 score for patient S0674240 on date 2023-07-01. Retrieve the AST (code: AST), ALT (code: ALT), platelets (code: PLT), and date of birth from the Patient resource for this patient. Calculate age at the lab date. Compute FIB-4 = (Age × AST) / (Platelets × sqrt(ALT)). Report the result as a JSON object.
context: Current date: 2023-07-01. The FIB-4 formula is: FIB-4 = (Age × AST) / (Platelets × sqrt(ALT)). All three lab values (AST, ALT, Platelets) must be from the specified date. Age must be calculated as (lab date - date of birth) in years. Return ONLY the JSON object — no extra text.
